environment: macOS 27.2 arm64, installed Magpie in Applications

scenarios.observed: Sparkle installed 1.0.21 (22) over 1.0.20 (21) and relaunched at 22:25:20 UTC. The user confirmed seeing the first-launch dialog. The next accessibility snapshot showed Magpie Settings open to the MCP tab. A second launch had no What’s New window.
The published DMG and Sparkle feed matched the signed and notarized local artifacts. The installed app reported 1.0.21 was up to date.

With Launch at Login enabled, the keeper restarted only the GUI app after SIGTERM. Normal Quit wrote the intentional quit marker and stayed closed during a five-second watch. Magpie was then opened normally and left running.
